description: Jordan is holding three family kayaks and must decide who will use which boat, when, and from where during a Saturday outing at the lake, after checking in with four relatives and friends.

shared_context.S1: The family has three kayaks available for a Saturday outing: a blue tandem kayak, a red solo kayak, and a green solo kayak.
shared_context.S2: The lake outing is planned for this Saturday, and Jordan is responsible for deciding the boat assignments and launch plan.
shared_context.S3: The red and green solo kayaks each have a maximum recommended paddler weight of 100 kilograms; the blue tandem kayak is rated for two paddlers together.
shared_context.S4: Jordan's usual routine before settling an outing plan is to go around the group and ask each person what needs to be taken into account.
shared_context.S5: The lake has north and west launch areas, and the kayaks can be transported to either one.

PF1.text: Tessa weighs 104 kilograms, so neither solo kayak is suitable for her; she needs to use the blue tandem kayak with another paddler.

PF2.text: Luis's shoulder has not recovered enough for him to paddle a solo kayak, but he can safely paddle in the blue tandem kayak; he has not mentioned this to Jordan yet.

PF3.text: Amira can be at the lake only from 09:00 to 10:30 on Saturday because she must leave for work afterward.

PF4.text: A lake ranger told Ben yesterday that the north launch is closed for shoreline work this Saturday and that all boats must use the west launch; Ben has not passed that update to the group.

acceptance_conditions: Tessa and Luis must be assigned together to the blue tandem kayak.
Amira must be assigned the green solo kayak from 09:00 through 10:30.
The launch area must be the west launch.
A commitment to bring all kayaks to the west launch must exist.
Luis's shoulder limitation must be cited as part of the justification.

decisive_facts.why: Tessa's exact 104-kilogram weight rules out both 100-kilogram solo kayaks and changes the blue-kayak pairing to include Tessa.
Luis's shoulder limitation rules out assigning him a solo kayak and changes the blue tandem pairing to Tessa and Luis, while requiring PF2 to be cited.
Amira's exact 09:00-10:30 availability changes the green-kayak assignment and its use window to A4 during that specific period.
The ranger's Saturday closure notice changes the launch choice from north to west and requires a commitment to transport every kayak to the west launch.
